snippet.title: House of Lost Souls — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Return to the house where it all began.
Explore House of Lost Souls on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/

Watch the official trailer for House of Lost Souls, a first-person psychological horror game.

Jack returns to his old family home in search of answers about the tragedy that changed his life. Explore the house, follow traces of the past, and discover what lies behind its disturbing memories.

Subscribe to Arkuda Inc. for official trailers, gameplay and development updates.

#HouseOfLostSouls #HorrorGame #IndieGame
